status.empty: Log your first weight to start seeing your trend.
status.stale: It has been {{days}} days since your last entry. The trend is no longer reliable.
status.sparse: With fewer than {{min}} entries in the last 7 days, the average is not reliable yet.

due.daily: You have not logged today's weight yet.
due.weekly: A week has passed since your last entry: time to weigh in.

ok.daily: You are up to date. Keep it up so the average stays reliable.
ok.weekly: You are up to date with your weekly entry.

tip.daily: Weigh yourself after waking up, after using the bathroom and before eating. Weight swings 1 to 2 kg from day to day with water and food, so the 7-day average is shown. Aim for 3 or more entries a week.
tip.weekly: Always weigh yourself on the same day at the same time, after waking up and before eating. Each week is compared with the one before.

bmi.label: BMI
bmi.note: WHO ranges for adults. BMI cannot tell muscle from fat: if you lift, it may read high. Use it only as a reference.
bmi.missing: Add your height to see your BMI. It is only used for that calculation.
